spans.s: BP0315 वैशेषिकः vaiśeṣikaḥ one of the orthodox indian philosophy postulated by Ācharya kanada and famous for molecular theory

DG0387 वैशेषिक गुण vaiśeṣika guṇa specific property; property specifically attributed to a particular mahābhūta & can be percieved only by one sensory organ; e.g. smell attributed to Pṛthvī mahābhūta & can be percieved by olfactory sense.
AF2421 वैस्वर्यं vaisvaryaṁ Hoarseness of voice.
